question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3 **i.e.** Proceedings'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **context of the sentence **relates to the legal activities in the Supreme Court.
 
• The **blank requires a term** that represents the activities or matters considered in courts.
 
• **"Proceedings" **(कार्यवाही) refers to the process of appearing before a court of law to achieve a specific outcome. It captures the entirety of a case, including its beginning, course, and end.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the Supreme Court reviews the **"proceedings"** or legal matters from lower courts.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Arrangement"** (व्यवस्था) usually refers to the process of organizing or setting up something, and it doesn't fit in the context of the sentence related to legal matters.
 
• **"Punctuality"** (समयनिष्ठता) means the quality of being on time. This term is unrelated to the activities or decisions of the court.
 
• **"Battles"** (संघर्ष) are intense fights or struggles and don't fit the legal context of the sentence.
